test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Refer to the following letter, number, symbol series and answer the question.

(Left) R 5 $ 3 9 G C P $ E 2 # 8 @ M # 1 D Z 4 Q & (Right)

If all symbols are dropped from the series, which of the following will be fifth from the right?
solution:
Given terms: (Left) R 5 $ 3 9 G C P $ E 2 # 8 @ M # 1 D Z 4 Q & (Right)

If all the symbols are dropped from the series then the arrangements are:

(Left) R 5 3 9 G C P E 2 8 M 1 D Z 4 Q (Right)

Here,

Fifth from the right end is: '1'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
